In accordance with FedRAMP requirements and policies the CSP CuraPatient has completed the FedRAMP review process and is ready to support agency requests. 

CuraPatient provides a secure, user-friendly experience Artificial Intelligence (AI) powered digital platform that drives sustainable efficiency across complex operations. The platform provides secure integration with client systems and multi-device accessibility, including native iOS, Android, and responsive web applications. CuraPatient’s core functionalities streamline key processes such as medical claims processing, patient engagement, reduce administrative tasks and support scalable/ secure operations. Our commitment to FedRAMP requirements reflects our dedication to protecting sensitive data, ensuring we maintain and uphold the highest security standards.
